name: payment_holiday_capitalized_once_bp_rate
question_template: A fictional loan has balance {BAL} USD at the start of month 1 and a payment of {PMT} USD per month. Its annual nominal rate is {RATE_BP} basis points; the regular monthly rate is that annual rate divided by 12. A payment holiday covers months 1 and 2: no payments, and deferral interest accrues at {DEF_PCT} percent per month on the month-1 opening balance only, uncompounded. At the end of month 2 the accrued deferral interest plus a one-time fee of {FEE} USD is capitalized once into the balance. From month 3 the original payment resumes at month end; each month adds interest at the regular monthly rate on the opening balance, then subtracts the payment. Report the regular monthly rate in percent, the capitalized amount, and the balances after the first and after the {N}th resumed payment.

slots.description: Regular monthly rate in percentage points, converted from annual basis points
Uncompounded two-month deferral interest plus fee added to the balance once
Balance after the first resumed month-end payment following capitalization

program:
def solve():
    bal = Q(P["BAL"])
    bp = Q(P["RATE_BP"])
    defp = Q(P["DEF_PCT"])
    pmt = Q(P["PMT"])
    fee = Q(P["FEE"])
    n = int(P["N"])
    if n < 1:
        raise ValueError("need at least one resumed payment")
    r = bp / 10000 / 12
    monthly_rate_pct = r * 100
    deferral_interest = bal * (defp / 100) * 2
    capitalized = deferral_interest + fee
    b = bal + capitalized
    first = None
    for k in range(1, n + 1):
        b = b + b * r - pmt
        if b <= 0:
            raise ValueError("loan repaid before the stated month")
        if k == 1:
            first = b
    return {
        "final": b,
        "monthly_rate_pct": monthly_rate_pct,
        "capitalized_amount": capitalized,
        "balance_after_first_resumed": first,
    }
